read.en: Nebius has chopped sideways since its August earnings jump, between about $204 and $255. Price just slipped under the 30-day ($226) and 100-day ($224) averages, which sit almost on top of each other, and below the 5 and 10-day. MACD crossed below its signal on Oct 8 and RSI is a neutral 47. The 200-day ($171) is far below and still rising, so the bigger trend is intact.
read.zh: Nebius 自8月财报跳涨后横盘震荡，区间约 $204–255。股价刚跌破几乎重叠的 30 日（$226）与 100 日（$224）均线，也低于 5 日与 10 日均线。MACD 于10月8日下穿信号线，RSI 47 中性。200 日均线（$171）远在下方且仍上行，大趋势未变。

read.en: Support is $204, the bottom of the recent range, then $193, the close before the August report that gapped the stock up. Below that the 200-day near $171 is the line for the longer trend. Resistance is $224–226 (the averages just overhead), then $255 (Oct 6 high) and the June record near $287. Moves of 5–8% a day are normal here.
read.zh: 支撑为 $204（近期区间底部），其次为 $193（8月财报跳空前收盘价）。再往下，约 $171 的 200 日均线是长期趋势分界。阻力为 $224–226（上方均线），然后是 $255（10月6日高点）及6月约 $287 的纪录。该股单日 5–8% 的波动属常态。

s.en: Close before the August gap up
